alt: 2027 Ford Super Duty pickup truck showing the front hood and grille where the water-drain design flaw was located
story: Ford's Super Duty trucks ship with a hood cowling that funnels rainwater through a hole directly above the fuse box; when the lid fails to seal (common), water destroys the electronics for a ~$700 repair — and the 2027 fix is a small plastic diverter that also retrofits 2023–2026 trucks as a $20 drop-in part.
why_funny: Four model years to add a plastic rain deflector to stop the hood from acting as a precision irrigation system aimed at the most sensitive electronics in a $90,000 truck.
